notes.title: [Correction Patch] Climbing Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I want to extend my sincere thanks to the Dubhe community for helping me identify an issue.

Today, I would like to announce the implementation of a correction that resolves a bug in the climbing system.

With this correction, the climbing system now functions as intended.

Please keep sending your feedback and suggestions!

Thank you for playing!

tags.bug: With this correction, the climbing system now functions as intended.

notes.title: Essential Fixes and Adjustments
notes.content:
Hello, Kalia explorers!

I'm happy to bring you a new update for Kalia. Every fix and adjustment is made with great care to improve your experience within the Ruin.

This small update focuses on crucial enhancements:

Fixed: Issues where pumps remained directly activated.

Adjusted: The floating platforms for better adaptation to challenges.

Thank you immensely for your patience and continued support as I build Kalia. Your feedback is invaluable!

tags.bug: Fixed: Issues where pumps remained directly activated.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted: The floating platforms for better adaptation to challenges.

notes.title: Kalia Update: Implementing Puzzles for the Next Phase!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Marcinho Manga here, solo dev of Kalia. I'm pleased to share that Kalia is progressing to the next development phase, and I'm fully focused on creating and implementing the new puzzles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/06e6fb1634497929760feef8013bfc689105e530.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/18d1d2d13951b92b4cc25b1d623ec7a65429d580.png[/img]

This stage is crucial for the game, as I'm designing challenges that will test your reasoning skills and enrich the exploration experience. My goal is for each enigma to be engaging and rewarding for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/583ca6f3594c6dd312988872c1aff1055058d894.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525211/8e9aa7c97f94cdf488992630a42555a0af0323fb.png[/img]

I deeply appreciate everyone who has already wishlisted Kalia. Your support is a huge encouragement for me as a solo dev.

Keep following for future updates. Kalia's development is moving steadily forward!

Sincerely,
Marcinho Manga

tags.feature: I'm fully focused on creating and implementing the new puzzles!
